attributes.name: confirmed_at
attributes.label: confirmed_at
attributes.meaning: Server-recorded UTC business time; caller may not supply this field.

attributes.name: subtotal_minor
attributes.label: subtotal_minor
attributes.meaning: Tier unit price multiplied by the agreed quantity, before tax. In CNY minor units (fen), never a floating-point yuan amount.

attributes.name: gross_amount_minor
attributes.label: gross_amount_minor
attributes.meaning: Tax-inclusive order value, rounded half up once to a minor unit. In CNY minor units (fen), never a floating-point yuan amount.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.label: quantity
attributes.meaning: Buyer-agreed total quantity, positive and fully deliverable.

attributes.name: retention_bps
attributes.label: retention_bps
attributes.meaning: Contractual retained warranty share, inclusive range 0..10000.

attributes.name: daily_penalty_bps
attributes.label: daily_penalty_bps
attributes.meaning: Penalty basis points per started 24-hour period, inclusive range 0..10000.

attributes.name: delivery_deadline
attributes.label: delivery_deadline
attributes.meaning: Agreed delivery acceptance deadline in UTC; a contract term, not a server stamp.
